category_l2: MessageSet duplicate-tag parsing and memory exhaustion

fixed_releases.verified_content: At the v3.20.2 commit a20c65f, ParseMessageSetItemImpl declares enum class State { kNoTag, kHasType, kHasPayload, kDone }, rejects out-of-order payloads, and skips duplicate payload bytes with ms.SkipField; v3.20.1 has no State enum and uses last_type_id/message_data sentinels

title: protobuf-cpp MessageSet parser lacks explicit state and accepts duplicate tags, leading to memory exhaustion

category_l2: quadratic parse cost in TextFormat via MessageReflection.BuilderAdapter.newMergeTargetForField copying the existing sub-message

fix_commits.branch: main (3.21.x); backported to the 3.20 branch for 3.20.3
fix_commits.message: Clean up TextFormat parser (#10673): CHANGES.txt records 'Fix TextFormat parser to build up recurring (but supposedly not repeated) sub-messages directly from text rather than building a new sub-message and merging the fully formed message into the existing field.' message.

fixed_releases.verified_content: Tag v3.20.3 (annotated tag 66b473b3, peels to commit fe271ab7) contains java/core/src/main/java/com/google/protobuf/MessageReflection.java with git blob 294d8417, byte-identical to the blob produced by fix commit a3888f5. That file has hasNestedBuilders, getFieldBuilder(), the MessageLite.Builder branch in setField, the getFieldBuilder-based mergeMessage/mergeGroup/newMergeTargetForField, and finish() returning the builder. v3.20.1 has blob b7f5d52d and none of these.

title: protobuf-java TextFormat parser rebuilds and re-merges a singular sub-message on every occurrence, giving quadratic work on crafted text input
vulnerable_commit_basis: Tag v3.20.1 is a lightweight tag that points directly at refs/tags/v3.20.1 = 21027a27c4c2ec1000859ccbcfff46d83b16e1ed, the snapshot commit; the CNA range 3.20.0 <= v < 3.20.3 contains 3.20.1, and the fix commit a3888f5 is not an ancestor of it

category_l2: Unbounded recursion: nested START_GROUP wire-type fields inside unknown fields recurse through UnknownFieldSchema.mergeFrom with no depth limit, so a crafted message overflows the Java stack

fix_commits.message: Add recursion check when parsing unknown fields in Java.

fixed_releases.verified_content: At v3.25.5 UnknownFieldSchema declares DEFAULT_RECURSION_LIMIT=100 and a static recursionLimit, and the START_GROUP case of mergeOneFieldFrom increments currentDepth, throws InvalidProtocolBufferException.recursionLimitExceeded() at the limit, and passes currentDepth into mergeFrom; at v3.20.1 the START_GROUP case calls mergeFrom(subFields, reader) with no depth check and the class has no limit constant.
